data.name: Prohibition
data.detailed_description:
Game:

You're a bootlegger in an alternate world gripped by a modern dictatorship. The government drug "B" is more than an escape from reality—it's a tool of control, plunging people into artificial euphoria and dulling their will to resist. Alcohol isn't a luxury; it's a weapon. It neutralizes "B," awakens true emotions, powers machines and hearts, and sparks a revolution. This is the world of Alkopunk: a gritty blend of punk and alcohol smuggling, where every drop of liquor is a step toward freedom. Start as a small-time hustler and rise to become a legend of the underground, crafting forbidden drinks, building an empire, and igniting a revolution against the regime.

Story:

Picture an alternate world where a modern dictatorship rules with an iron fist. The drug "B" is not just medicine—it's a tool to keep the masses submissive, drowning them in artificial euphoria. Here, alcohol is more than a drink; it's a weapon. It breaks the hold of "B," restores real emotions, fuels machines, and becomes the fire for revolution. This is the Alkopunk world, where smuggling spirits is the path to freedom.

In the heart of this chaos, you're a bootlegger. Your life changes as you dive into the criminal underworld, evading authorities and brewing illicit drinks. Over time, you assemble a gang, seize city districts, and challenge the dictatorship. Fate pulls you into a web of intrigue, corruption, and rebellion, where your choices could either topple the regime or lead to your downfall.

Features:

  • Action-adventure: Run an underground empire from a first-person perspective, blending combat, resource management, and cunning deals.

  • Alkopunk world: Explore grim urban districts, craft unique alcoholic drinks with special effects, and immerse yourself in a society torn apart by prohibition and control.

  • Dynamic progression: Rise from a lone smuggler to an underworld boss—recruit a gang, seize territories, and build your reputation through risky operations.

  • Intense combat: Engage in thrilling first-person battles, using improvised weapons, tactics, and alcohol-fueled abilities.

  • Resource management: Gather ingredients, upgrade your distilleries, and balance risks to keep your operation thriving despite constant threats.

  • Atmospheric immersion: Dive into a dystopian world inspired by classic mafia stories with a punk twist, where alcohol is the key to liberation.

In a world ruled by dictatorship, craft forbidden alcohol that counters the drug "B," manage your gang, seize districts, and build an underground empire. Intense first-person combat and resource management await you in this full-fledged adventure!
